episode.title: Just Resting His Eyes
episode.scene: Living room, late evening. A warm brass floor lamp casts a honey-gold pool of light across the sagging patchwork sofa. Teddy, an enormous shaggy apricot Syrian hamster, has completely deflated into a heavy, sprawling loaf on the cushion, cheek squished flat against a dusty sage knit blanket in deep slumber, with one tiny stubby paw still resting loosely over an uncracked sunflower seed. Beside his massive sleeping form, tiny silvery-white Ichigo sits bolt upright, neat dorsal stripe crisp along her spine, rounded ears perked high, staring down at him with a deadpan tilt of her pointed muzzle and bristling whiskers.
episode.caption: He specifically asked for the long version.
episode.arcNote: Teddy fell asleep immediately after asking Ichigo to tell him a full story.
